description: This image displays a two-level sunburst or donut chart representing a hierarchical categorization of tasks, featuring an inner ring with three main categories and an outer ring with nine sub-categories. The inner ring consists of three slices labeled in bold white text directly inside the segments: "Contradiction Resolution" (brownish-red), "Context Tracking" (dark blue), and "Context Retrieving" (dark teal). The outer ring is divided into nine slices that are color-coded to align with their corresponding inner categories, with labels and numerical values positioned outside the chart and connected to their respective segments via thin blue lines. Adjacent to the "Contradiction Resolution" section are three red-hued slices: "Prioritization" (light red, 100), "Personalization" (orange-red, 100), and "Privacy Protection" (bright red, 111). Bordering the "Context Retrieving" section are three green and cyan-hued slices: "Multitasking" (teal, 160), "Dynamic Instruction" (bright turquoise, 100), and "Memorization" (light cyan, 100). Surrounding the "Context Tracking" section are three blue-hued slices: "Dynamic Environment" (dark blue, 100), "Recursive Reasoning" (bright blue, 110), and a light blue slice at the top with a partially cut-off label showing the value "100". The chart does not include a separate legend, uses thick white borders to visually separate all slices, and does not appear to order the segments by size.
